notes: The page is saturated with words that are all in _GENERIC_TAGS — zoo, museum, park, state-park, trail, trails, hiking, nature, animals, history, visitor-info, new-york — so a model tagging by salient vocabulary produces exactly the tag set the graph refuses to link on.
